title: Emergency measures.
bodyText: The department of health may implement emergency measures to refuse, modify, or limit attendance at any school in the State pursuant to section 321-1 if it is determined that there is imminent danger of an epidemic or serious outbreak of communicable disease.
bodyHtml: [§302A-1133]  Emergency measures.  The department of health may implement emergency measures to refuse, modify, or limit attendance at any school in the State pursuant to section 321-1 if it is determined that there is imminent danger of an epidemic or serious outbreak of communicable disease. [L 1996, c 89, pt of §2]
